title: Maximising the number of solutions to linear equations
summary: We study the asymptotically maximal possible number of integer solutions to the linear equation $ax+by+cz = 0$ with a fixed choice of $a, b, c \in \mathbb{Z}$ and variables $x, y, z \in S$ for some finite set $S\subset \mathbb{Z}$, as $|S|\to +\infty$. Define $γ_{a, b, c}$ to be the largest constant for which there are arbitrary large finite sets $S\subset \mathbb{Z}$ such that the number of solutions to $ax+by+cz=0$ with $x,y,z\in S$ is $γ_{a,b,c}|S|^2-o(|S|^2)$.
